subject: Business Models
title: The Triangular Trade
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Triangular Trade.

hook.text: A brutal three-legged trade route connected Europe, Africa, and the Americas for over 300 years.

buildup.text: European goods went to Africa. Enslaved people were shipped to the Americas. Raw materials returned.

discovery.text: This system built enormous wealth for European empires while devastating African and indigenous societies.

twist.text: Many 'respectable' institutions—banks, insurers, universities—were funded by triangular trade profits.

climax.text: Abolition movements eventually ended the slave trade, but its economic legacy shaped the modern world.

punchline.text: Commerce built empires. Not all business models are ethical.

quiz.question: What three regions did the Triangular Trade connect?
